name: Ferienwohnung Notburga
beschreibung: The Holiday Apartment Notburga is located in Thiersee, a village in the Tiroler Kaiserwinkl near Walchsee. The building offers access to hiking and cycling trails in the surrounding area, as well as, in winter, cross-country ski trails and ski areas in the region. The apartment is simply furnished and equipped with a kitchenette, a bedroom, and a living area. Guests can use a balcony and a small garden. Parking spaces are available.
